title: QazRuFake: a Kazakh-Russian benchmark of fact-checked claims and news posts for fake news detection
description:
QazRuFake is a corpus of 7,213 short texts in Russian (3,866) and Kazakh (3,347) for fake news detection in Kazakhstan's bilingual information space. Its 3,133 FAKE items are claims checked by Kazakhstani fact-checking organisations (Factcheck.kz, Kazinform, Aqparat Saqshysy, NoFake.kz) and assigned to FAKE by documented corpus rules: Russian claims debunked by the outlet, and Kazakh claims with Factcheck.kz verdicts false, fake, mostly false or manipulation. REAL items combine claims rated true by Factcheck.kz, news reports from fact-checking outlets and news posts (Tengrinews.kz, Kazakh-language outlets); the label basis of every source is documented.

The release contains grouped train/dev/test splits, original fact-checker verdicts, claim-only versions of all texts with channel and framing removed, fine-grained fake-news type and technique labels with a double-annotated agreement sample, per-item SVM, XLM-R and zero-shot LLM predictions, an artefact-aware evaluation protocol, LaBSE embeddings, and code for all experiments.
